New temperatures are never persisted, and the requirement to record time+temp and preserve entries is not met.

Meanwhile `load_cache` parses lines with `split(":")[1]`, but an ISO timestamp contains colons, so `"London: 2023-01-01T12:00:00 +12C"` splits into `['London',' 2023-01-01T12','00','00 +12C']` and `[1]` becomes `'2023-01-01T12'`. Any value without a leading timestamp (as written by `save_cache`) would make `datetime.fromisoformat(...)` raise a ValueError. The reader and writer disagree on the format.

The program therefore crashes on the first city.
